_doc: AI key while the microphone cannot start (audit AUD5-003): nothing is asked in the user's name; once the expander and the audio chip set up, the next ask works.

ai.mic_unavailable.why: the first press finds the microphone unable to start

hub.requests.ai.ask.why: a press whose microphone did not start must not send a question the user did not ask

ai.answers.why: once the expander and the audio chip set up, the next ask is answered
